quota:snapshot.account.ref: ignored: an opaque reference used only to tell accounts apart; never shown
quota:snapshot.expiresAtMs: ignored: decides when the reading counts as old; the page says the reading is the last one rather than printing the time
quota:snapshot.schemaVersion: ignored: checked before anything is shown; a snapshot from an unknown collector version is refused
quota:snapshot.source: ignored: checked before anything is shown; a snapshot from an unknown collector version is refused
quota:snapshot.windows[].id: ignored: a window is named by its length (5-hour, this week), not by the collector's id
quota:snapshot.windows[].status: ignored: a window the provider did not report is left out
